evidence.reason: schema_problem indexes _SCHEMA_TYPES[t] for every schema type name, but _SCHEMA_TYPES has no "number" key. A deployment schema using type: "number" for a sampled receipt property therefore raises KeyError at current line 1089 instead of returning a violation, losing the receipt verdict/tick result and contradicting schema_problem's documented fail-closed, non-raising behavior. Return an unsupported-schema diagnostic for type names outside _SCHEMA_TYPES while preserving the local-review result.
